general.title: General
general.description: Application defaults and collaboration identity. Changes auto-save.

userId.label: Studio User ID
userId.description: Used as the local Git author and team owner.

defaultSkillFolder.label: Default skill folder
defaultSkillFolder.description: New skills are created here when no folder is chosen.

giteaHost.label: Gitea Host
giteaHost.description: Private Gitea host used for team collaboration.

remoteModelCatalog.label: Community model catalog
remoteModelCatalog.description: Download the verified community catalog for local route evidence and allow sanitized successful probe evidence to be contributed back. Turn off to stop both read and contribute paths.
remoteModelCatalog.configNote: System defaults (public, no secret) — override via STUDIO_COMMUNITY_CATALOG_* environment variables.

language.label: Language
language.description: Switch Studio UI copy without restarting the app.

truthSources.title: Runtime truth source files
truthSources.description: Single-source files and folders that own Studio runtime state.
truthSources.loadFailed: Runtime truth sources failed to load: {{error}}
truthSources.noLogs: No operations recorded for this file yet.
truthSources.previewTruncated: Preview is truncated because the file is large.

llm_runtime.label: LLM runtime truth
llm_runtime.description: Credential, route, role, and health stores owned by the backend.

diagnostics.label: Runtime diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Append-only diagnostics generated by backend operations.

app_settings.label: App settings
app_settings.description: Stores Studio UI preferences such as user id, default folder, language, and the community catalog toggle.

skill_index.label: Skill index
skill_index.description: Tracks indexed skills and workspace metadata used by the Studio shell.

workspaces_root.label: Workspaces root
workspaces_root.description: Root directory for user workspaces and writable skill folders.

default_skills_root.label: Default skills root
default_skills_root.description: Default writable skill root for the current local Studio profile.

llm_credentials.label: LLM credentials
llm_credentials.description: Single source of truth for provider endpoints, API keys, route status, and credential evidence references.

llm_roles.label: LLM roles
llm_roles.description: Stores role definitions, model groups, and routing bundles used by Studio runtime materialization.

llm_role_test_results.label: Role test results
llm_role_test_results.description: Persists role and copilot test outcomes shown by Studio diagnostics.

llm_health.label: LLM health database
llm_health.description: Local health and cooldown diagnostics for provider routing.

llm_canonical_rules.label: Canonical model rules
llm_canonical_rules.description: Optional canonicalization rules for provider and model identities.

runtime_activity_log.label: Runtime activity log
runtime_activity_log.description: Structured operation log showing what ran, when it ran, and what changed.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Local LLM provider credentials used by Studio runtime. Changes auto-save.
apiKeys.loadFailedDescription: {{error}}. Stored provider values are not shown until the credentials document loads.
apiKeys.backendReconnecting: Backend is reconnecting — please try again in a moment.

form.providerNameDuplicate: A provider with this name already exists.

llmRoles.description: Edit model and provider fallback order. Changes auto-save.

fast.description: Fixed role used by the engine's internal sub-tasks (e.g. md-patch, which surgically repairs md2json validation failures). It favors fast responses — best paired with small, fast models.

copilot_claude_opus_4_8.description: Built-in coding copilot role, kept in sync with the backend fallback chain.

copilot_deepseek_v4_pro.description: Coding copilot role, kept in sync with the backend fallback chain.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.description: Configure copilot roles with the same model group fallback pattern used by LLM Roles.
copilot.addModelTooltip: Pick a model group for the existing empty card first

emptyState.title: No Anthropic Messages route yet
emptyState.description: Add a credential that supports the anthropic-messages protocol in API Keys (Anthropic Official / Ark / DeepSeek / OpenRouter, etc.). It appears here once single-model testing passes.

roleCard.description: Coding copilot role synced with backend fallback chain.

testErrors.roleUnknown: {{title}} does not exist or was deleted. Refresh the page and try again.
